n_bfa1b88c89964857.name: Configure the review export
n_bfa1b88c89964857.source: export default function config({businessUnitId,spreadsheetId,generalSheet,helpfulSheet,maxPages}){if(!Number.isInteger(maxPages)||maxPages<1||maxPages>1000)throw Error('Set maxPages between 1 and 1000');if(typeof businessUnitId!=='string'||!/^[0-9a-f]{24}$/i.test(businessUnitId))throw Error('Configure a Trustpilot business unit ID');for(const [key,value] of Object.entries({spreadsheetId,generalSheet,helpfulSheet}))if(typeof value!=='string'||!value.trim()||value.startsWith('YOUR_'))throw Error('Configure '+key);if(generalSheet===helpfulSheet||/[!\r\n]/.test(generalSheet+helpfulSheet))throw Error('Choose distinct sheet names');const q=x=>"'"+x.replace(/'/g,"''")+"'";return{businessUnitId,spreadsheetId,generalSheet,helpfulSheet,maxPages,generalRange:q(generalSheet)+'!A:ZZZ',helpfulRange:q(helpfulSheet)+'!A:ZZZ'}}

n_9a315cb9d71edb77.name: Collect review pages
n_9a315cb9d71edb77.source: export default function collect({previous,response,businessUnitId,maxPages}){const s=previous??{reviews:[],count:0,token:null,seen:[],started:false};const base='https://api.trustpilot.com/v1/business-units/'+businessUnitId+'/all-reviews';if(!s.started)return{state:{...s,started:true},more:true,url:base,reviews:[]};if(!response||typeof response!=='object'||!Array.isArray(response.reviews))throw Error('Invalid Trustpilot response');const reviews=[...s.reviews,...response.reviews],token=response.nextPageToken;if(token==null)return{state:{...s,reviews},more:false,url:base,reviews};if(typeof token!=='string'||!token||s.seen.includes(token))throw Error('Invalid Trustpilot page token');if(s.count+1>=maxPages)return{state:{...s,reviews},more:false,url:base,reviews};return{state:{...s,reviews,count:s.count+1,token,seen:[...s.seen,token]},more:true,url:base+'?pageToken='+encodeURIComponent(token),reviews:[]}}

n_5bfa3f3052734942.name: Match reviews to sheet rows
n_5bfa3f3052734942.source: export default function plan({reviews,generalValues,helpfulValues,generalSheet,helpfulSheet}){if(!Array.isArray(reviews))throw Error('Invalid reviews');const gf=['Date','Author','Body','Heading','Rating','Location','review_id'],hf=['title','comment','rating*','status*','verified','feedback*','review_id','product_id*','review_date*','customer_email','customer_name*'];function sheet(values,fields){if(!Array.isArray(values)||!values.length||!Array.isArray(values[0]))throw Error('Sheet needs headers');const header=values[0];if(fields.some(x=>header.indexOf(x)<0||header.indexOf(x)!==header.lastIndexOf(x)))throw Error('Sheet needs unique required headers');const indexes=Object.fromEntries(fields.map(x=>[x,header.indexOf(x)])),map=new Map();for(let i=1;i<values.length;i++){let row=values[i];if(!Array.isArray(row))throw Error('Invalid sheet row');let id=row[indexes.review_id];if(id==null||id==='')continue;if(typeof id!=='string'||map.has(id))throw Error('Invalid or duplicate sheet review ID');map.set(id,{index:i+1,raw:row})}return{indexes,map,next:values.length+1}}const g=sheet(generalValues,gf),h=sheet(helpfulValues,hf),seen=new Set(),tasks=[];for(const r of reviews){if(!r||typeof r.id!=='string'||!r.id||seen.has(r.id))throw Error('Invalid or duplicate review ID');seen.add(r.id);if(!Number.isInteger(r.stars)||r.stars<0||r.stars>5||typeof r.isVerified!=='boolean'||typeof r.createdAt!=='string'||!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T/.test(r.createdAt)||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(r.createdAt)))throw Error('Invalid review fields');if(!r.consumer||typeof r.consumer.displayName!=='string'||!r.consumer.displayName.trim())throw Error('Missing reviewer name');for(const k of ['title','text'])if(r[k]!=null&&typeof r[k]!=='string')throw Error('Invalid review text');if(r.consumer.displayLocation!=null&&typeof r.consumer.displayLocation!=='string')throw Error('Invalid reviewer location');const get=(x)=>x.map.get(r.id)??{index:x.next++,raw:[]},gt=get(g),ht=get(h),title=r.title??'',text=r.text??'',name=r.consumer.displayName;tasks.push({id:r.id,general:{...gt,indexes:g.indexes,fields:{Date:r.createdAt,Author:name,Body:text,Heading:title,Rating:r.stars,Location:r.consumer.displayLocation??'',review_id:r.id}},helpful:{...ht,indexes:h.indexes,fields:{title,comment:'','rating*':r.stars,'status*':'published',verified:r.isVerified?'yes':'no','feedback*':text,review_id:r.id,'product_id*':'','review_date*':r.createdAt.slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,'/'),customer_email:'','customer_name*':name}}})}return{tasks,generalSheet,helpfulSheet}}

n_f58ec266fb3b814c.name: Select the next review
n_f58ec266fb3b814c.source: export default function next({tasks,previous,confirmation,generalSheet,helpfulSheet}){const s=previous??{index:0,waiting:false};if(s.waiting){if(confirmation!==18)throw Error('Both sheet updates were not confirmed');s.index++;s.waiting=false}if(s.index>=tasks.length)return{state:s,more:false,item:{},generalRange:"'unused'!A1:ZZZ1",helpfulRange:"'unused'!A1:ZZZ1"};const item=tasks[s.index];if(!item||!Number.isSafeInteger(item.general?.index)||!Number.isSafeInteger(item.helpful?.index))throw Error('Invalid review task');const range=(sheet,index)=>"'"+sheet.replace(/'/g,"''")+"'!A"+index+':ZZZ'+index;return{state:{...s,waiting:true},more:true,item,generalRange:range(generalSheet,item.general.index),helpfulRange:range(helpfulSheet,item.helpful.index)}}

n_40b1e1cc6d460699.name: Prepare the review cells
n_40b1e1cc6d460699.source: export default function update({item,generalChecked,helpfulChecked,generalSheet,helpfulSheet}){const checked=(value,raw)=>Array.isArray(value)&&value.length<=1&&JSON.stringify(value[0]??[])===JSON.stringify(raw);if(!checked(generalChecked,item.general.raw)||!checked(helpfulChecked,item.helpful.raw))throw Error('Review sheet row changed');const col=n=>{let x=n+1,s='';while(x){x--;s=String.fromCharCode(65+x%26)+s;x=Math.floor(x/26)}return s},data=[];for(const [sheet,part]of [[generalSheet,item.general],[helpfulSheet,item.helpful]]){let q="'"+sheet.replace(/'/g,"''")+"'";for(const [key,value]of Object.entries(part.fields))data.push({range:q+'!'+col(part.indexes[key])+part.index,values:[[value]]})}return{data}}
